title: A volcano split in two
text: A volcano that erupted about 23 million years ago near present-day Lancaster was cut in half by the San Andreas Fault. One half stayed in the Antelope Valley area as the Neenach Formation. The other half is now Pinnacles National Park, {distance} {direction} of here.

sentences.text: A volcano that erupted about 23 million years ago near present-day Lancaster was cut in half by the San Andreas Fault.
One half stayed in the Antelope Valley area as the Neenach Formation.
The other half is now Pinnacles National Park, {distance} {direction} of here.

s1.title: Neenach Volcano
s1.quote: The volcano formed 23 million years ago. ... The Neenach Volcano was situated directly over the primary San Andreas fault, causing it to be split in two ... both halves of the volcano have moved about 195 miles (314 kilometers) apart.
